description: This file implements the EffectProxy class for managing audio effect sub-effects in Android's media framework, including creation, destruction, parameter setting, and command handling.

classes.name: EffectProxy
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of audio effect sub-effects, providing methods to create, destroy, configure, and control effects.

methods.name: addSubEffect
methods.description: Adds a sub-effect to the proxy, ensuring UUID consistency and initializing flags.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates all sub-effects via the factory.

methods.name: getEffectReturnParam
methods.description: Retrieves the effect return parameters of the active sub-effect.

methods.name: setOffloadParam
methods.description: Sets offload parameters for the appropriate sub-effect based on offload mode.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens all sub-effects with given parameters.

methods.name: getDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptor of the active sub-effect.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Sends a command to the active sub-effect.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Gets the current state of the active sub-effect.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter on the active sub-effect.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter from the active sub-effect.

methods.name: runWithActiveSubEffectThenOthers
methods.description: Runs a function on the active sub-effect and then on others if successful.

methods.name: runWithActiveSubEffect
methods.description: Runs a function on the active sub-effect.

methods.name: runWithAllSubEffects
methods.description: Runs a function on all sub-effects.
